title: Medical visa for treatment in India | TIB HIND
description: Medical visa invitation letters for treatment in India. Written opinion with costs within 48 hours. NABH and JCI accredited hospitals only.
h1: Medical visa for treatment in India
lede: India issues e-Medical Visas for treatment. TIB HIND provides your hospital invitation letter so you can apply with the documents immigration expects to see.
heroBody: Treatment in India needs more than a diagnosis and a flight. The e-Medical Visa asks you to prove that a genuine hospital appointment exists. Our invitation letter does exactly that.

cta.note: Free. No obligation. A written opinion within 48 hours.

byline: Visa guidance prepared by TIB HIND Healthcare
Invitation letters issued within 2–3 working days
Editorial policy

sections.label: Overview
sections.h: Why a visa letter is needed
ps: India issues an e-Medical Visa to patients travelling for treatment. Applying online is straightforward, but the visa officer and immigration expect to see a genuine medical reason: a hospital letter, a medical summary, and for many nationalities an invitation letter from the treating hospital or facilitator.
That letter is the difference between a smooth arrival and a difficult one. The patient must be able to produce it at immigration on arrival.
ul: Confirms the treatment and the hospital to the visa officer
Shows immigration why you are in India and how long you will stay
Matches your application with your actual hospital appointment

sections.label: Countries
ps: TIB HIND issues medical visa invitation letters for patients from eight countries. If yours is not listed, write to us anyway — we will tell you honestly what you need.
ul: Iraq
Bangladesh
Uzbekistan
Oman
Yemen
Sudan
Ghana
Ethiopia

sections.label: Steps
ps: The e-Medical Visa is applied for online through the official Indian government portal. You must apply at least four days before travel — we recommend starting about a week ahead.
ul: Send your reports and passport copy to TIB HIND
Receive your invitation letter and hospital documents within 2–3 working days
Apply online for the e-Medical Visa with your letter
Wait for the approved e-visa, then book your flight to Delhi
Carry your invitation letter and medical summary, and show them at immigration on arrival

sections.label: What we issue
ps: When your case is accepted, TIB HIND issues a formal invitation letter on hospital letterhead together with the supporting documents you need for the visa application.
ul: A medical visa invitation letter naming the hospital and treatment
A written medical opinion with costs, usually within 48 hours
Hospital contact details for the visa officer
Only NABH and JCI accredited hospitals in Delhi NCR

faq.q: How long does it take?
faq.a: Your invitation letter is usually issued within 2–3 working days of our reviewing your reports. The e-Medical Visa is applied for online and you should allow at least four days — we recommend starting about a week before you plan to travel.

faq.q: How much does the letter cost?
faq.a: Usually nothing. We do not charge for the invitation letter itself. You still pay the Indian government's e-visa fee directly when you apply.

faq.q: What if my visa is refused?
faq.a: Send us the refusal notice. We will review it with you, adjust the invitation or documents if that is the problem, and support a fresh application. We will not press you to spend money on a visa that is unlikely to be granted.
